blocks.text: HOBART — Walking to work under the majestic southern lights is among the many highlights for Bureau of Meteorology technical officer Nelson Clegg. The 34-year-old from Western Australia is in his third stint in the far south as an Australian Antarctic Program employee. The program on Thursday opened recruitment for more than 200 roles for the 2027/28 Antarctic season, with plenty of skilled trade workers needed to deliver research station improvements. “You can be walking to work at 10 o’clock in the morning and have an aurora over your head,” Mr Clegg, who is currently posted at Davis station, said. “Getting […]...
